name: Bloom
concept: Colour arrives as light: feathered radial glow behind 1px-stroked cards on near-black.

type.families: Geometric sans (Aeonik, General Sans, Satoshi). Headlines set tight at -0.025em; italic is permitted for emphasis inside a headline.
type.hierarchy: Hero 56/60 medium · section 32/38 medium · body 15/24 regular in `--muted` · micro-caps 10/12 medium ALL-CAPS 0.12em with a small bullet dot. Body text is deliberately grey, not white — only headlines get full `--ink`.
type.usage: Sentence case headlines, tracked micro-caps as section eyebrows. Never set long body copy in pure white on black — it vibrates. Cap paragraph width at 62 characters.

tokens.texture: Colour arrives as light, never as fill. Cards are defined by a 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.10)` stroke over an almost invisible 3% white fill — no solid card colours. Behind them, one or two large feathered radial gradients (`radial-gradient(60% 50% at 30% 0%, var(--glow-a) 0%, transparent 70%)`) bleed from an edge or from behind a 3D hero object. Add 2-4% noise over the whole page to stop the gradients banding.
tokens.layout: Modules butted edge to edge with hairline dividers and zero gutters, so the page reads as one continuous dark surface subdivided by light. 8px scale, 28-32px module padding, 14px radius. The hero object (a faceted, iridescent or chrome 3D form) is the only saturated mass; everything else is stroke and glow.

avoid_for: dense working dashboards used all day

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as 3D render, iridescent or chrome material, dark studio.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- near-black background #08080D with deep falloff
- one faceted or organic 3D form as the sole subject, iridescent indigo-to-magenta refraction
- light appears as a soft feathered bloom around the object, not as a lamp
- subtle film grain across the whole frame
- no ground plane — the object floats in void

NEGATIVE SPACE: The lower 40% falls to near-black for text overlay.

DO NOT INCLUDE: flat vector, white or light backgrounds, hard rim lighting, text or UI in the image, busy multi-object scenes, warm orange casts.
image_recipe.provider: configurable — set to your image provider

image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square

light appears as a soft feathered bloom around the object, not as a lamp
